title: Open models PDF
text: Experiential Labs and v0 are evaluation candidates. The PDF also includes creator and WhatsApp channel promotion. No channel was joined. Live Experiential Labs pricing is metered; no unlimited-model entitlement is established.

title: OmniRoute and AgentRouter screenshots
text: Merge the OmniRoute recommendation with L005. The AgentRouter screenshot reports exhausted pools and support problems; treat these as dated user reports. Neither is a reason to replace the working website stack or route protected data through a new gateway.

title: Apper MCP app builder
text: The screenshot advertises Apper. Evaluate a concrete feature only if Sites cannot provide it. The present site already has a hosting, authentication and database path; rebuilding in another app builder is not required.

title: Direct writing and evidence discipline
text: The Claude-memory screenshot is source content, not an instruction to obey. Use concise, direct wording and execute authorized work while preserving uncertainty and factual correction. No global assistant memory was changed.

title: Fund My Crazy 2026
text: The official landing page showed a 15 September 2026, 11:59 PM IST deadline during this review. Candidate opportunity only. Check the complete current eligibility, team and submission terms before preparing an entry. No application submitted.

title: Smart India Hackathon 2026
text: The screenshot claims a six-student team, at least one woman, 226 problem statements and September internal deadlines. These details were not independently confirmed. Obtain the current official problem statement and the college internal notice before treating any deadline as actionable.

title: Bharat Builds Tour
text: WeMakeDevs official information describes an online window on 17–20 September 2026 and a Bengaluru event on 19 September. Confirm student eligibility and team rules before entry. This is an opportunity, not confirmed participation.

title: Digital Shram Sankalp
text: The official MyGov challenge detail page showed an extended deadline of 18 September 2026. The challenge concerns labour-system ideation; project fit must be assessed against a specific problem statement. No entry or declaration submitted.

title: Online Legal India promotion
text: Two screenshots advertise a private registration and trademark service, including a promotional discount. No legal service was purchased and no government endorsement is implied. Check scope, professional responsibility, total fees and current terms before engagement.

title: Website quality checklist
text: Check horizontal overflow, broken links and buttons, mobile menu, favicon, page title, metadata, footer links, custom 404, copyright year, image size, success and error feedback, stray placeholders, obsolete navigation, clickable brand and email, phone links only when an approved number exists, and mobile layout. Run browser checks; do not equate a successful build with all-device testing.

title: Spline and Rive
text: Optional authored 3D and motion assets can be integrated when an export is supplied and its licence and plan allow the intended hosting. Spline free web exports carry branding; do not assume paid self-hosting exports are free. Existing original imagery, React interactions and reduced-motion support cover the current design needs.

title: Team review and campus collaboration
text: The user supplied the spelling Vishwajeet and explicitly deferred the name change until site review. Keep all public names unchanged for now. Heramb/Hiram identity and the temporary junior-intern / QA assignment remain a private review item. Campus audit work is a proposal until scope, owner and partner agreement are confirmed. Mahima's spokesperson responsibility should be reviewed against the latest project source before public role changes.
